scope: Provisional scholarly concept roles for the 61 existing method.* entities; NO changes to canonical records

vocabulary.problem_formulation: A mathematical objective/constraint/inference problem, not a concrete numerical algorithm
vocabulary.method_family: A reusable broad class of computational methods and many possible implementations
vocabulary.algorithm: A relatively specific computational procedure or update rule
vocabulary.numerical_scheme: A class of numerical discretizations, approximation or integration schemes
vocabulary.model_family: A distribution/model representation shared by many architectures or algorithms
vocabulary.model_architecture: A relatively specific neural architecture or architectural variant
vocabulary.learning_strategy: A training objective, supervision mechanism or learning procedure
vocabulary.inference_strategy: An inverse-calibration/prediction workflow or conditioning strategy
vocabulary.diagnostic_or_design: An analysis or design method assessing information, identifiability or measurements
vocabulary.physical_model: An explicit mechanistic model or physical boundary-model construction
vocabulary.software_framework: A programming/infrastructure framework that implements a class of methods

method.bayesian-inverse-problems.review_note: Broad inverse-problem formulation: retain as canonical entity but do not portray as peer to NUTS.

method.bi-variational-pino.review_note: Paper-specific coronary architecture: distinguish generalizable method extension from a domain-specific application.

method.deep-galerkin.review_note: PDE neural solver training method (residual), not the classical Galerkin finite-element method.

method.deep-ritz.review_note: Variational-energy neural solver training method, not identical to standard FEM.

method.derivative-informed-operator.review_note: Primarily derivative/sensitivity-informed training; inspect whether separate architecture identity is warranted.

method.difftaichi.review_note: Software implementation platform with an associated differentiation technique; not a standalone numerical PDE formulation.

method.diffusion-probabilistic-model.review_note: DDPM denotes a family of diffusion modeling algorithms; not one fixed network architecture.

method.flow-matching.review_note: Training strategy for continuous normalizing flows; literature relationship should not imply all normalizing flows descend from FM.

method.generative-adversarial-network.review_note: GAN is a broad adversarial generative model class, not one network backbone.

method.learned-forward-inversion.review_note: Workflow pattern: surrogate-assisted inversion can use many different architectures; consider a strategy node, not a specific algorithm.

method.markov-chain-monte-carlo.review_note: Broad sampler family; NUTS is one member through HMC rather than direct historic evolution from all MCMC.

method.model-predictive-control.review_note: Framework with many algorithms and dynamical-model choices; may be a family-level concept.

method.neural-operator.review_note: Methodological family/function-space learning formulation, not a single architecture.

method.nonlinear-least-squares.review_note: Mathematical optimization problem, not itself an update algorithm; Gauss–Newton/LM address it.

method.normalizing-flow.review_note: Family of invertible probabilistic models; FM is a training technique for the continuous subclass.

method.pde-constrained-optimization.review_note: Problem/formulation class; discretization and adjoint gradients are techniques used to solve it.

method.physics-informed-deeponet.review_note: Architecture with added physics-based training; review whether the apparent fusion and extension links encode distinct claims.

method.physics-informed-diffusion.review_note: Physics-residual training strategy applied to a generative family; not a general guarantee of exact PDE satisfaction.

method.pinn.review_note: Family of neural physics-residual solution methods, not one universal architecture.

method.score-based-sde.review_note: Continuous-time unifying generative formulation; its relation to DDPM is not just a linear descendant.

method.simulation-based-inference.review_note: Broad inference setting and family including posterior, likelihood and ratio estimation.

method.variational-inference.review_note: Family of posterior approximation/optimization methods; VAE uses VI, not necessarily an equal-level algorithm merge.

method.windkessel.review_note: Physical lumped model and boundary-condition construction, not a numerical optimization algorithm.
